en: A vintage winter street scene showing a broad, snow-covered avenue lined with multi‑storey stone buildings on the left and trees on the right. People in long coats and hats walk along the street, and horse‑drawn vehicles appear in the distance. The image has a tinted, hand‑colored look. Text printed in red identifies the street and city, and there is a museum attribution printed at the bottom.
